changes.before: Required a high energy use facility site assessment before rezoning, special exception, or special use permit approvals, with mandatory noise review within 500 feet and optional review of water, agriculture, parks, historic, and forest impacts.
changes.after: As-passed summary describes a proposal requiring a high energy use facility site assessment before rezoning, special exception, or special use permit approval, including sound effects on residential units and schools within 500 feet of the property boundary and optional review of water, agriculture, parks, historic sites and forestland. It also describes an existing-approval expansion/modification exception subject to qualified additional-power wording and preserves local zoning authority. The exact exception boundary and enrolled text remain unverified; enrolled text was not retained in the inspected attempts.
